## Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have witnessed a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict, shattering the fragile peace memorandum signed earlier this month. After US airstrikes targeted Iranian missile, drone, and radar sites in retaliation for an attack on a cargo vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran retaliated with drone and missile strikes against Bahrain and Kuwait, further imperiling an interim deal. Meanwhile, the Ukraine war continues with Kyiv striking a key Russian oil hub, and naval developments in the Indo-Pacific and Europe signal ongoing force modernization and geopolitical competition. Here are the key takeaways:

- **US-Iran Escalation: A New Phase of Hostilities** – The US military struck multiple targets in Iran on Friday and Saturday, marking the first US strikes since the peace memorandum was signed. President Trump warned about Iran's fate, stating the US may 'militarily complete the job.' Iran responded by targeting US allies Bahrain and Kuwait with drones and missiles, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ordered vessels to turn back in the Strait of Hormuz. ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed), [PBS](https://news.google.), [Politico](https://news.google.))

- **Ceasefire Under Strain: Regional Spillover** – The conflict has directly drawn in Gulf states, with Iranian drones attacking Bahrain and a ship struck in the strait. The US and Iran continue to trade attacks and recriminations, threatening the war-ending memorandum. Iran claims the US strikes violate the deal, while the US cites 'continued aggression' against shipping. ([Reuters](https://news.google.), [IntelliNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPZXdDR0tnZ1Y3Z3JtVEFwa0tGWTh3ajJYVXpaQllqSWRwUG5xU3l0UmZUVE1IME9yVjRMbm95Q1NodTIwOWN4MzFiWFN3eXh1bUJNajdVVmlqM2d6cTBWdWhfQ3RMRzY1cHUxN2hvYUptNGVrTEZpR1hoUVh3YlU2RTliNHVkSGk2cWdaWGpVTjFzRUkxcVpLOU5mNjdLV2lsLTBlOVkyVGZhOVBrVjNlZnFIMU9vZjdWeXc))
